extracted.name: Easy Pea Salad
extracted.description: This is a really simple side dish featuring peas and cheese. I double the recipe and take it to many family gatherings.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup creamy salad dressing, e.g. Miracle Whip ™
instruction_lines: In a medium serving bowl, mix together the peas, Cheddar cheese and onion. Stir in the sugar and creamy salad dressing. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
